verdict.rationale: OpenHands offers its own routes to unattended runs: an auto-approve-all-actions CLI option, 'API support for automation and scripting', and SDK guides under a github-workflows path that automate PR triage. However, the documented CLI is described as an interactive default mode, and no explicit headless or non-interactive flag or CI pipeline recipe is shown. missing for 10: documented headless/non-interactive CLI flag (e.g. single-task run with exit codes), explicit CI/CD pipeline setup docs (GitHub Actions/GitLab job examples), shell-script usage examples, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run an agent headlessly inside CI/CD pipelines and shell scripts

citations.quote: API support for automation and scripting
